provenance.note: Hill and mean-excess statistics in numpy; the threshold-stability rows by bounded minimisation of the concentrated pooled likelihood on a one-factor Student t world; the semi-parametric law with an empirical body and generalised Pareto tails fitted by Nelder-Mead, evaluated with scipy's genpareto; the covariate generalised Pareto (log scale linear in two covariates, one shape) by BFGS polished with Nelder-Mead on the full likelihood, its standard errors from the same step-scaled central-difference Hessian.
